Copy the SDK and CLI packages from your Extensions SDK download into this folder
(Ableton's license doesn't allow redistributing them), for example:

    ableton-extensions-sdk-1.0.0-beta.1.tgz
    ableton-extensions-cli-1.0.0-beta.1.tgz

The file names must match the ones in package.json. If your SDK version is
different, update package.json and run `npm install`.
